Context: (vii) Timing restrictions.-

(viii) In case of stay/ journey on Government ships, boats, etc. or journey to remote places on foot/mules, etc. for scientific/data collection purposes in organization like FSI, Survey of India, GSI, etc., Daily Allowance will be paid at rate equivalent to that provided for reimbursement of food bill. However, in this case, the amount will be sanctioned irrespective of the actual expenditure incurred on this account with the approval of the Head of Department/Controlling Officer.
